outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental workflow, not a plot of quantitative data.
Bar graph shows mean ± SD with individual data points (n=4 dots per group) overlaid on each bar.
Scatter/dot plot displaying mean with 95% CI shows each individual mouse's tumor volume as a separate point.
Bar graph shows mean ± SD with individual replicate data points overlaid on each bar.

This line plot shows only the mean tumor volume ± SEM at each time point for each group; individual animal tumor volume trajectories are not displayed, obscuring the spread/variability underlying the averages.
Bar graph of CD4 intensity shows mean ± SD with individual field measurements plotted as points over each bar.
Bar graph of pERK intensity shows mean ± SD with individual field measurements plotted as points over each bar.
